summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the platform-specific bun binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line JavaScript blob with hex-named identifiers and a shuffled string-array decoder (WV8StW rotator over n7gIxM) whose contents are not human-readable. The declared purpose of the package is a Jest preset for react-native-web; jest-preset.js only throws a deprecation error, and Bun is not required for that stated purpose. The net effect of `npm install @ornikar/jest-config-react-native-web@12.0.8` is that an alternate language runtime is fetched at install time and used to execute an opaque obfuscated payload on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
